mapper.sql: opl.id, opl.order_no, opl.merchant_id, m.name as merchant_name, opl.distributor_id, d.name as distributor_name, opl.pay_amount, opl.merchant_amount, opl.platform_amount, opl.distributor_amount, opl.merchant_rate, opl.platform_rate, opl.distributor_rate, opl.status, opl.profit_sharing_attempts, opl.profit_sharing_last_attempt_time, opl.profit_sharing_next_retry_time, opl.profit_sharing_out_order_no, opl.profit_sharing_order_id, opl.finish_time, opl.remark, opl.del_flag, opl.create_time, opl.update_time
mapper.select: select from order_profit_ledger opl LEFT JOIN merchant m ON opl.merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN distributor d ON opl.distributor_id = d.id where opl.id = #{id} and opl.del_flag = '0'
select from order_profit_ledger opl LEFT JOIN merchant m ON opl.merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN distributor d ON opl.distributor_id = d.id where opl.order_no = #{orderNo} and opl.del_flag = '0' limit 1
mapper.insert:
insert into order_profit_ledger
order_no, merchant_id, distributor_id, pay_amount, merchant_amount, platform_amount, distributor_amount, merchant_rate, platform_rate, distributor_rate, status, finish_time, remark, del_flag,
values
#{orderNo}, #{merchantId}, #{distributorId}, #{payAmount}, #{merchantAmount}, #{platformAmount}, #{distributorAmount}, #{merchantRate}, #{platformRate}, #{distributorRate}, #{status}, #{finishTime}, #{remark}, '0',
on duplicate key update id = id
mapper.select: select from order_profit_ledger opl LEFT JOIN merchant m ON opl.merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN distributor d ON opl.distributor_id = d.id where opl.del_flag = '0' and opl.status in ('WAITING_SETTLEMENT', 'WECHAT_PROFIT_SHARING_FAILED') and COALESCE(opl.profit_sharing_attempts, 0) < #{maxAttempts} and (opl.profit_sharing_next_retry_time is null or opl.profit_sharing_next_retry_time <= NOW()) order by COALESCE(opl.profit_sharing_next_retry_time, opl.update_time, opl.create_time) asc, opl.id asc limit #{limit}

select from order_profit_ledger opl LEFT JOIN merchant m ON opl.merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN distributor d ON opl.distributor_id = d.id where opl.del_flag = '0' and opl.status = 'WECHAT_PROFIT_SHARING_PROCESSING' and opl.profit_sharing_out_order_no is not null order by opl.update_time asc, opl.id asc limit #{limit}
select COALESCE(SUM(merchant_amount), 0) from order_profit_ledger where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and del_flag = '0'
select COALESCE(SUM(platform_amount), 0) from order_profit_ledger where del_flag = '0'
select COALESCE(SUM(distributor_amount), 0) from order_profit_ledger where distributor_id = #{distributorId} and del_flag = '0'
select COUNT(*) from order_profit_ledger where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and del_flag = '0'

select from order_profit_ledger opl LEFT JOIN merchant m ON opl.merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN distributor d ON opl.distributor_id = d.id where opl.distributor_id = #{distributorId} and opl.del_flag = '0' order by opl.create_time desc
